reviews.title: SL240 Liquid Cooler
reviews.comment: Its a great price and the LCD screen is awesome. I have been running it for about two weeks and its very quiet and I have it on a 5950X and keeps the temps when gaming around 63C with the fans around medium speed and not too loud at all . Cooling I give it an A+ with no issues and I have read reviews about pump noise and I would suggest to make sure you have 12 volts on the header the pump is plugged into or you will have pump noise due to reduced pump speed . I started computer went into BIOS and checked voltage and pump speed on the header and had to adjust the voltage to FULL to make sure no issues as it was not 12 volts initially and you could hear pump but once changed , no issues . This probably can also be changed in Windows once booted using motherboard software but make sure you have full voltage to pump or it will make noise !! I love the LCD screen and it feels high quality for the money , I have no regrets . You will Love It !

reviews.title: Broken with no response from their customer service
reviews.comment: I was very excited when I received this for my birthday. I had had it in my cart for a while and was ready to put it in. Only problem was when I received it it was broken. The box had no dents scratches or anything. But the actual device itself look like it had been dropped and then back in. I reached out to customer service via email with no response. The bend and crack in the radiator caused one of the fans to not work. The device itself is pretty damn cool and the idea behind it is even cooler. I feel like I just kind of got the 💩 end of the stick here and now I'm being ignored by the manufacturer. Pretty shifty and rude. I've now emailed them three separate times.
reviews.author: Pickle Rick

reviews.author: Ellie

reviews.title: Great AIO
reviews.comment: I ordered this for my nephew and helped him install it in his prebuilt PC. The original builders skimped on the air cooling for the CPU the Ryzen 7 ran very hot. This cooler keeps it around 55-60 even under a heavy gaming load and the pc is dramatically quieter! Looks great and functions great with the install video for aid. It wasn’t too bad on the install but with the way new coupling technology is progressing on fans it could have streamlined the installation with less wiring but it’s doable as is. Recommend.
reviews.author: Austin
